# Economics of Health Care Markets

::: {.text-secondary .fs-4}

Use the tools of microeconomic theory and basic data analysis to understand insurance markets, health care decision making, hospital pricing and competition, and pharmaceutical innovation

Fall 2026<br>
Department of Economics<br>
Emory University<br>
